scientific_question: Can compact latent momentum decoded through the actual fixed BlockFHT Jacobian preserve dense Muon's matrix direction after polarization and exact tangent pullback?

primary_measurement.weight_decay: excluded because the proposed linear generated chart applies its own decoupled coordinate decay separately
primary_measurement.candidate: positive-step line recovery of P * polar(P * combined_momentum_update)
primary_measurement.oracle: positive-step line recovery of P * dense_polar_update
primary_measurement.raw_control: positive-step line recovery of P * combined_momentum_update
primary_measurement.aggregation: dense-polar Frobenius-energy weighted across 4 steps x 5 layers x 2 targets

decision_rule.pass_action: authorize optimizer implementation and exact-config MFU preflight only
decision_rule.fail_action: reject projected weight-space Muon without training

scope_guard: This gate evaluates actual fixed BlockFHT generation. It does not authorize the prior refresh-15 dense folded-weight optimizer, a learned basis, LoRA, radial/spectral repeats, or a larger rung.
